description: Primary keywords: assign list load Assign, load, or get information on an mpoint constitutive model. This command associates a constitutive model with specified mpoint. It also allows querying of properties and states of constitutive models, and dynamic loading of user-defined mechanical models as DLLs.

keywords.name: assign
keywords.description: Assign a mechanical material model to all mpoints in the range. The mechanical constitutive models are described in Constitutive Models, and the creep models are in Creep Constitutive Models. Null Mechanical Models

keywords.name: kwd:null
keywords.description: Assign the null model. For most purposes, null models are ignored by default (see the Null model description).

keywords.name: kwd:anisotropic
keywords.description: Assign the transversely-anisotropic elastic model (see the Anisotropic model description).

keywords.name: kwd:elastic
keywords.description: Assign the isotropic elastic model (see the Elastic Model description).

keywords.name: kwd:orthotropic
keywords.description: Assign the orthotropic elastic model (see the Orthotropic model description).

keywords.name: kwd:columnar-basalt
keywords.description: Assign the columnar-basalt elasto-plasticity model, known also as COMBA model (see the Columnar-Basalt model description).

keywords.name: kwd:concrete
keywords.description: Assign the concrete elasto-plasticity model (see the Concrete model description).

keywords.name: kwd:cap-yield
keywords.description: Assign the cap-yield elasto-plasticity model, known also as CYSoil model (see the CYSoil model description).

keywords.name: kwd:cap-yield-simplified
keywords.description: Assign the simplified cap yield elasto-plasticity model, known also as CHSoil model (see the CHSoil model description).

keywords.name: kwd:double-yield
keywords.description: Assign the double-yield (cap) elasto-plasticity model (see the Double-Yield model description).

keywords.name: kwd:drucker-prager
keywords.description: Assign the Drucker-Prager elasto-plasticity model (see the Drucker-Prager model description).

keywords.name: kwd:hoek-brown
keywords.description: Assign the Hoek-Brown elasto-plasticity model (see the Hoek-Brown model description).

keywords.name: kwd:hoek-brown-pac
keywords.description: Assign the Hoek-Brown-PAC elasto-plasticity model (see the Hoek-Brow-PAC model description).

keywords.name: kwd:modified-cam-clay
keywords.description: Assign the modified Cam-Clay elasto-plasticity model (see the modified Cam-Clay model description).

keywords.name: kwd:mohr-coulomb
keywords.description: Assign the Mohr-Coulomb elasto-plasticity model (see the Mohr-Coulomb model description).

keywords.name: kwd:mohr-coulomb-tension
keywords.description: Assign the Mohr-Coulomb elasto-plasticity model with tensile strain crack tracking, known also as the MohrT model (see the Mohr-Coulomb-Tension model description).

keywords.name: kwd:norsand
keywords.description: Assign the norsand model — a critical state model applicable to soils in which particle to particle interactions are controlled by contact forces and slips rather than bonds (see the NorSand model description).

keywords.name: kwd:plastic-hardening
keywords.description: Assign the elasto-plasticity model with shear and volumetric hardening, known also as PH model (see the Plastic-Hardening model description).

keywords.name: kwd:soft-soil
keywords.description: Assign the soft-soil model for soil with significant compression (see the Soft-Soil model description).

keywords.name: kwd:softening-ubiquitous
keywords.description: Assign the strain-softening/hardening elasto-plasticity model with bilinear failure and ubiquitous joints, known also as the SUBI model (see the Softening-Ubiquitous model description).

keywords.name: kwd:strain-softening
keywords.description: Assign the strain-softening/hardening elasto-plasticity model (see the Strain-Softening model description).

keywords.name: kwd:swell
keywords.description: Assign the Mohr-Coulomb elasto-plasticity model considering wetting-induced deformation (see the Swell model description).

keywords.name: kwd:ubiquitous-joint
keywords.description: Assign the Mohr-Coulomb elasto-plasticity model with a plane of weakness, known also as UBI model (see the Ubiquitous-Joint model description).

keywords.name: kwd:ubiquitous-anisotropic
keywords.description: Assign the model with a plane of weakness and with anisotropic elasticity (see the Ubiquitous-Anisotropic model description).

keywords.name: kwd:von-mises
keywords.description: Assign the Von-Mises elasto-plasticity model commonly for metal-like materials(see the Von-Mises model description).

keywords.name: kwd:finn
keywords.description: Assign the dynamic pore-pressure generation elasto-plasticity model (only available for the dynamic option; see the Finn model description).

keywords.name: kwd:p2psand
keywords.description: Assign the p2psand model refers to a Practical TWO-surface Plastic SAND constitutive model for general 3D geotechnical earthquake engineering application (see the P2PSand model description).

keywords.name: kwd:imass
keywords.description: Assign the IMASS model (only available for the imass option; see the IMASS model description).

keywords.name: kwd:burgers
keywords.description: Assign the classical viscoelastic model known as the Burgers substance which composed of a Kelvin model and a Maxwell model (only available for the creep option; see the Burgers model description).

keywords.name: kwd:burgers-mohr
keywords.description: Assign the viscoplastic model combining the Burgers model and the Mohr-Coulomb model (only available for the creep option; see the Burgers-Mohr model description).

keywords.name: kwd:maxwell
keywords.description: Assign the classical viscoelastic model known as the Maxwell substance, known also as Maxwell model (only available for the creep option; see the Maxwell model description).

keywords.name: kwd:power
keywords.description: Assign the two-component power law model used for mining applications (only available for the creep option; see the Power model description).

keywords.name: kwd:power-mohr
keywords.description: Assign the viscoplastic model combining the two-component Power model and the Mohr-Coulomb model (only available for the creep option; see the Power-Mohr model description).

keywords.name: kwd:power-ubiquitous
keywords.description: Assign the viscoplastic model combining the two-component Power model and the Ubiquitous-Joint model (only available for the creep option; see the Power-Ubiqitous mdoel description).

keywords.name: kwd:soft-soil-creep
keywords.description: Assign the soft-soil-creep model for soil with time-dependent behavior such as the creep that develops during the secondary compression (see the Soft-Soil-Creep model description).

keywords.name: kwd:wipp
keywords.description: Assign a reference creep model commonly used in thermomechanical analyses associated with studies for the underground isolation of nuclear waste in salt (only available for the creep option; see the WIPP model description).

keywords.name: kwd:wipp-drucker
keywords.description: Assign the viscoplastic model combining the WIPP model and the Drucker-Prager model (only available for the creep option, see the WIPP-Drucker model description).

keywords.name: kwd:wipp-salt
keywords.description: Assign the viscoplastic model modified from the WIPP model, and includes volumetric and deviatoric compaction behavior for salt-like materials (only available for the creep option; see the WIPP-Salt model description).

keywords.name: kwd:hydration-drucker-prager
keywords.description: Assign the modified Drucker-Prager for hydration (only available for the thermal option; see see the Hydration-Drucker-Prager model description).

keywords.description: Not yet implemented
